roles.current_affiliation: Maritsa Vegetable Crops Research Institute, Bulgarian Agricultural Academy, Plovdiv, Bulgaria (prior: Agricultural University - Plovdiv)
roles.field: Plant physiology; non-destructive techniques for evaluating abiotic and biotic plant stress and crop monitoring; photosynthesis under stress; biostimulants
roles.career_stage: Approximately 4 years post-PhD. PhD 2020 (summa cum laude); thesis 'Non-destructive evaluation of physiological status of drought-stressed tomato plants' (doi:10.2139/ssrn.5492527).
roles.note: Operator-confirmed real fellow. Her non-destructive plant-stress-physiology expertise supplies the project's biological ground truth (RQ4 validation strength).
